mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTIFICATIONS (user_id, type, message, is_read, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{message}, #{isRead}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, type, message, is_read, created_at, updated_at FROM NOTIFICATIONS WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
